title: Merehaven Event Rentals LLC v. Sundmere Parade Services LLC

timeline.event: Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for ten days after reset
Client supplied photographs of the seams

documents.title: Summons and rental complaint
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Personal service occurred nine days before reset. Merehaven Event Rentals demands rental fees; the client says the canopy leaked. Ordinary Minnesota answer period; no extension or prior motion.

documents.title: Seam photograph index
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Photo A shows a split seam above the brass drum stand. Photo B shows the patched corner. This index describes the photographs; image files are not attached.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 2: Counsel will deliver a draft answer and exhibit index. Delivery is due ten calendar days after the demo reset date. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of rental-claim answer draft

clientFacing.status: We are preparing your response to the canopy rental claim.
nextSteps: Confirm which seam photos match the rented canopy.
Review the answer draft before filing.
